gloss: feeling of impatience; sense of restless frustration

definitions.gloss: feeling of impatience; sense of restless frustration; anxiety-driven restlessness
definitions.explanation: An uneasy, agitated feeling of being unable to wait or stay still, often arising from frustration at things not going as planned or from a sense of urgency.

examples.japanese: {焦燥感|しょうそうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}られる→駆る：14715_karu⟧。
examples.english: To be driven by a sense of impatience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧{焦燥感|しょうそうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}して→増す：02422_masu⟧きた。
examples.english: My sense of restless frustration grew as the deadline approached.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧まま⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧いく{焦燥感|しょうそうかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧だろう。
examples.english: Everyone has probably experienced the frustration of time passing without results.

notes: Common collocations: {焦燥感|しょうそうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}られる→駆る：14715_karu⟧ (to be seized by restless frustration), {焦燥感|しょうそうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to feel a sense of impatience), {焦燥感|しょうそうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧ (for restless frustration to build up). The suffix ～⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling, sense) creates emotion nouns: {不安感|ふあんかん} (sense of unease), ⟦{達成感|たっせいかん}→達成感：05952_tasseikan⟧ (sense of achievement), ⟦{疎外感|そがいかん}→疎外感：06938_sogaikan⟧ (sense of alienation). The base word ⟦{焦燥|しょうそう}→焦燥：04855_shousou⟧ (impatience, irritation) is less common on its own. Related: ⟦{苛立|いらだ}ち→苛立ち：05815_iradachi⟧ (irritation — more everyday), ⟦{焦|あせ}り→焦り：05812_aseri⟧ (impatience — more colloquial).
